source_text: A prospective cohort study of 420 primigravida women at Omdurman Maternity Hospital in Sudan found that 76.9% of those who had undergone FGM reported dyspareunia, compared to significantly lower rates in uncircumcised women (p < 0.001), with type III infibulation (prevalent in 67.8% of cases) contributing to scarring and adhesions that exacerbate painful intercourse. [32]
